description: 量化实盘参数档位配置

quality_regime_candidate_v22_relaxed_low.profile_note: v22 diagnostic: keep low-vol-but-liquid candidates out of hard tradability filter; later liquidity/pretrade/optimizer still enforce capacity and risk.

quality_regime_candidate_v24_conditional.profile_note: v24 shadow: based on v22 but applies a milder holiday-gap cap only when signal_to_trade_gap and post_trade_gap both trigger; tests combined-gap cash drag without relaxing simple-gap protection.

quality_regime_candidate_v25_liquidity_t.profile_note: v25 shadow: based on v24 but uses liquidity_score for final target weights to test whether the positive final-pool liquidity spread can survive capacity/industry/ADV constraints and P2 smoke. Default remains quality_regime.

quality_regime_candidate_v26_liquidity_n.profile_note: v26 shadow: based on v25 liquidity target score but uses NAV-weighted style exposure in daily/P2 pretrade to test whether positive liquidity target-alpha can deploy without the invested-weighted style cash trap. Default remains quality_regime.

quality_regime_candidate_v27_primary_res.profile_note: v27 shadow: based on v26 but isolates primary alpha by using portfolio_rank_score for target weights and capping active reserve exposure at 2%; reserve pool remains available for execution replacement. Default remains quality_regime.

quality_regime_candidate_v23_nav_weighte.profile_note: v23 diagnostic: keep v18 signal/portfolio settings but evaluate pretrade style exposure on NAV-weighted exposure instead of invested-average single-name exposure.

quality_regime_candidate_v28_ranking_gat.profile_note: v28 shadow: based on v27; tests diagnosed alpha decay at filtered_signal_pool -> ranking_pool_pre_pretrade, so this profile softens the pre-pretrade ranking quantile gate and uses a liquidity/exit-trap-safe target blend. Default remains quality_regime; cheap precheck only before any P2 spend.

quality_regime_candidate_v29_capacity_fe.profile_note: v29 shadow: based on v28; uses capacity-feasible alpha diagnosis to relabel primary/reserve candidates by target_blend_score topN before reserve caps. It does not relax ADV, industry, style, holiday, blocked-order, reserve, or exit-trap controls. Default remains quality_regime.
